a feelgood post about one of our luckiest rescues cezar sometimes in rescue you really need a story that reminds you why you keep going this is one of those stories cezar came from what we still refer to as the apartment of horrors it was a hoarding case in bucharest during the covid period a woman was keeping around 30 unneutered cats locked inside a small apartment we got involved after reports that cats were being thrown out of a fifthfloor window some of those cats could be saved some couldnt thats how bad it was animal police were called the woman refused access for a long time and even tried to smuggle some cats out before letting them in eventually they managed to enter we were there in the building hallway when the door finally opened ive been doing rescue for many years im desensitized to the smell of feces urine vomit decay all of it but that apartment i was wearing a mask standing in the hallway and when the door opened just enough for someone to come out the smell hit me so hard i almost vomited on the spot the apartment owners family had no idea what was happening inside one of them went in came back out and just started crying the apartment was completely destroyed inside animal police found no food bowls no water bowls no litter boxes nothing for legal reasons all we can say is that some of the cats came into our care cezar was one of them we suspect many of the cats were inbred because they shared very similar features cezar was special a little slow cognitively but incredibly gentle and he had the worst ear mite infestation ive ever seen in my life from day one he was a good boy the plan was simple fix his health keep him a few weeks find him an adoption weeks turned into months space was very limited and cezar was a highenergy cat one day i took him to the vet on a leash and thats when i realized just how unique he was he didnt mind the harness at all he was stealing pens from the vets trying to make friends with every dog walking up to every person in the waiting room like he owned the place thats when i thought what if i actually walk him up until then i was very much against walking cats on a leash too many get scared and try to break freee but cezar had zero interest in escaping he just wanted to explore so i started taking him out to the park on little adventures to an animal rights march giving him the best life i could even while living in a rescue environment with limited space then something amazing happened a friend from another ngo cats on fire offered to help her sister could foster cezar that foster turned into an adoption and today cezar is living his absolute best life from an apartment of horrors to parks adventures and a home of his own hes one of the luckiest rescues weve ever had and honestly one of the best cats imaginable

robotics awareness humanoid robots powered by raspberry pi robotics awareness humanoid robots powered by raspberry pi introduction robotics is rapidly transforming the way humans interact with technology among the most exciting developments is the rise of humanoid robotsrobots designed to resemble human shape movement and behavior with the availability of affordable computing platforms like the raspberry pi building intelligent humanoid robots is no longer limited to large research labs today students hobbyists and innovators can explore humanoid robotics using compact lowcost hardware this article raises awareness about how humanoid robots can be developed and operated using raspberry pi highlighting their importance capabilities and future potential what is a humanoid robot a humanoid robot is a robot that mimics the human body structure typically including a head arms legs and the ability to interact with its environment these robots are designed to perform tasks in humancentered environments such as homes schools hospitals and offices humanoid robots often focus on humanlike movement and gestures speech and facial recognition interaction and assistance learning and adaptation role of raspberry pi in humanoid robotics the raspberry pi is a small affordable singleboard computer capable of running a full operating system such as linux despite its size it offers powerful features that make it ideal for humanoid robotics gpio pins for controlling motors and sensors usb ports for cameras microphones and peripherals wifi and bluetooth for connectivity support a smalltime dealers brutal ascent through chinatowns criminal hierarchy sets off a chain reaction of betrayal violence and supernatural retribution that will consume everyone in its path hey everyone sharing the trailer for my short film super wok explosion releasing january 13th its a stylized episodic crime thriller set in chinatown following a group of young hustlers who spiral into a power struggle when ambition collides with forces far beyond their control the project was written and directed by me and produced entirely in blender over roughly 400 hours im not a professional animator this was never meant to be a showcase of technical realism my primary goal was simply to tell a story the visuals are intentionally stylized rather than naturalistic and some of the aesthetic decisions heavy shadows restrained motion limited detail were both creative choices and practical ones i leaned into darker lighting and minimalism to mask rough edges but also because it reinforced the mood and helped me make something that felt cohesive and personal rather than overly polished but empty from a production standpoint i focused on atmosphere over fidelity most scenes use sparse geometry paired with handplaced lighting rather than complex simulations neon reds and blues dominate the palette red representing violence and sacrifice blue suggesting detachment and judgment to externalize the characters inner states rather than depict reality asis camera movement is slow and deliberate often locked off allowing negative space pauses and music to carry tension looking back id do many things differently the scope is large with multiple plotlines that arent always fully explored some character motivations and criminal mechanics are intentionally abstract and not always tangible that may make the story less accessible for some viewers but it was a conscious tradeoff to prioritize worldbuilding and tone over exposition i see this project very much as part of a learning process especially in storytelling economy and clarity the original concept was a modern fairytale in the chinatown underworld the story centers on a group of initially nave infantile young men who believe theyre taking control of their fate only to become pawns in a nested matryoshkalike criminal structure the shadow organization at the top no longer believes in tradition or honor those ideas are merely tools vehicles for extraction and control violence is not moral or symbolic to them its purely instrumental many of the storylines explore the old making room for something new and that new order being colder more opaque more nihilistic this is most clearly expressed through the character of king whose arc revolves around the masculine myth he believes hes selfmade powerful and autonomous but in reality his identity is shaped by idolized archetypes around him rainman monk macau ronnie phil the myth doesnt empower him it isolates and ultimately destroys him the supernatural elements are literal not metaphorical inspired by filmmakers like jodorowsky and nicolas winding refn heightened reality was essential to externalize inner psychological and ideological forces to show how unseen systems beliefs and power structures manifest as something almost divine omnipresent and indifferent the reagan speech in the first episode was important to frame this contrast the promise versus what follows i dont try to take a clear political stance or make definitive claims the film is more a window into complex macro forces masculinity power organized crime and ideology viewed through the limited perspective of characters who dont fully understand the machinery shaping their lives i also built a companion site where i share research articles on asian organized crime and is greenland a part of the usa actually greenland is not part of the usa it is an autonomous territory of the kingdom of denmark the confusion often stems from the fact that greenland is geographically part of the north american continent and has been a major topic of us political interest for over 150 years as of early 2026 the us government has intensified its calls to acquire the island but it remains sovereign danish territory 1 who does greenland belong to greenland is one of three constituent parts of the kingdom of denmark alongside denmark proper and the faroe islands selfgovernance since 2009 greenland has had selfrule meaning it governs its own internal affairs like education health and natural resources danish control denmark still manages greenlands foreign policy defense and currency the danish krone 2 why is there a connection to the usa the united states has a very close relationship with greenland for two main reasons military strategy and natural resources military presence the us has operated pituffik space base formerly thule air base in northwest greenland since world war ii it is a critical part of the us earlywarning system for ballistic missiles geographic shield during the cold war and today greenland is seen as a shield for north america against threats coming over the arctic natural resources the island contains massive deposits of rare earth minerals which are essential for making smartphones electric vehicle batteries and military tech 3 has the us tried to buy it yes multiple times the us has viewed greenland as a real estate deal throughout history 1867 secretary of state william seward who bought alaska first explored buying greenland 1946 president harry truman offered denmark 100 million in gold for the island denmark refused 2019 20252026 president donald trump sparked international debate by repeatedly expressing a desire to acquire greenland calling it a national security priority current status 2026 while some us officials have recently suggested options ranging from a purchase to a compact of free association a treaty where the us provides defense in exchange for exclusive rights both the greenlandic government and denmark have consistently stated greenland is not for sale

why india is missing from trumps pax silica and what that really says about power today when donald trump announced the usled pax silica focused on critical minerals energy semiconductors and ai indias absence stood out but it shouldnt have surprised anyone pax silica isnt multilateralism in the traditional sense its transactional countries are included because they bring something usable now for exploring space include advancing scientific research national prestige uniting different nations ensuring the future survival of humanity and developing military and strategic advantages against
